privileged_info_for_vlm: The three papers must be changed from 'Single Field' (one text box) to 'Two Fields' (Last Name, First Name). Correct values: 1. Last: Shannon, First: Claude E. 2. Last: Turing, First: Alan. 3. Last: Huffman, First: David A. In many reference managers (like Zotero), the 'Single Field' mode is indicated by a single white box or a 'building' icon, while 'Two Field' mode shows two distinct boxes separated by a comma or space.
